advices.diagnosis: The OrderService class aggregates four unrelated responsibilities (order lifecycle, pricing, audit, notification), which is reflected by a critical LCOM4 of 5 and high NOM (26) and WMC (56). All attributes are private (DAM = 1.0), so encapsulation is not the issue; the problem is low cohesion and excessive size. The DCC of 4 shows it already depends on several internal types, and further splitting will likely increase that count modestly.

suggestions.title: Extract each component into its own service class

advices.risk_notes: Refactoring may break code that relies on the monolithic OrderService API; comprehensive integration tests are needed. The increase in DCC could be a concern if the project enforces strict layer boundaries, so place the extracted services in layers that match their responsibilities.
